howto: Pick Easy, Normal or Hard speed and press Play.
The snake waits until your first swipe or arrow key.
Steer to the apples: each one makes you longer and a little faster.
Don't hit the walls, your own tail or the rocks that appear as you grow.
tips: Grab ⭐ gold before it fades: +5, and it blasts a rock away.
A 👻 orb lets you slide through rocks for 5 seconds.
Eat apples quickly one after another to build an eat streak.
Every 5 apples is a new level; the snake speeds up a little with every apple.
When you get long, run along the edges so your tail can't box you in.

controls.keyboard: Arrow keys or WASD steer; Space starts. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Swipe on the board to steer

difficulty: Easy, Normal and Hard set the starting speed; on every level the snake gets faster, up to more than twice its starting speed.

cheats.effect: No walls: the snake wraps round to the other side
Gold rush: a gold star appears after every apple

features.difficulty: Easy, Normal and Hard speed on the title (remembered)
features.power-up-list: The title card lists the pick-ups: apples grow you, gold stars (+5) blast a rock, ghost orbs let you pass rocks for 5 s
features.wave-or-level-counter: LV in the top bar goes up every 5 apples, as the snake speeds up
features.high-score-table: Top 5 scores (with the speed) on the Game Over card; runs with codes on are left out
features.results: Game Over card with score, best, medal, gold, streak, level, rank and the top 5
